_provenance.derivation: Wire keys were extracted mechanically from the Rust struct, applying serde's own precedence (an explicit #[serde(rename)] on a field beats the struct-level rename_all). They were NOT transcribed from this SDK's ReleaseResource dataclass — a fixture built from the Python field names would encode the same assumption the parser makes and could not disprove it.
_provenance.rename_all: camelCase (serializer.rs:24) — this is 1 of only 10 attribute structs on the server that use it; MachineAttributes, PolicyAttributes, LicenseAttributes, ComponentAttributes and ProcessAttributes are all snake_case
